lesson: Not a defect (0159): Same contradiction as the rejected no-route-owner finding: decision 0159 §3 settles resetScope as the scope-bound /new reset that returns the retired references. T1-AC8's 'readonly empty list on no-route or empty paths' is the return-shape rule for a reset that matched nothing (verified by the 'resetScope returns … an empty list when nothing matched' Postgres integration test); it does not add a stop guard when a route owner cannot be resolved — that fallback is pre-existing base behaviour (f83779ce7 resetScope), the scope key already confines the reset to one conversation scope, and sessions without a conversation install legitimately have no route owner (CLI reset, fixture). Adding the guard fails the existing integration test. — raised as "T1-AC8: R4 return type: resetScope returns an immutable list of retired { providerSessionId, externalSessionId, executionProviderId } selected FOR UPDATE before"
